# ADR-NNN: <Decision, stated as a decision>

**Status:** Draft | Accepted (YYYY-MM-DD) | Superseded by [ADR-MMM](adr-MMM-noun.md)
**Related:** <ADRs, specs, PRDs this touches>

## Context

What forced this decision now. The constraint, the failure, the fork in the
road. A reader two years from now should understand the situation without
having been there.

## Decision

The decision, in one or two sentences, in the active voice ("We route
export-controlled queries via…"). Then the essential shape of the solution —
enough to be unambiguous, not a full design (that goes in the spec).

## Options considered

For each serious option: what it was, and the one or two reasons it lost.

## Consequences

What gets easier, what gets harder, what we're now committed to. Include
the follow-up work this creates.
